vulpin_m1.positive: A dark fantasy anime character portrait in shonen manga style with refined ink outlines and floating blue-white foxfire spirits casting an ethereal glow. A male vulpin is shown from the chest up — the most human-like of all therians, with delicate and refined facial features. He has elegant pointed fox ears angled slightly forward atop his head and a single large, fluffy, voluminous fox tail — the only tail — rising behind his left shoulder, rich russet-orange with a warm cream tip glowing in the foxfire light. His hair is rich russet-orange, worn loosely past his jaw. His eyes are striking golden amber, knowing and faintly amused. He wears a dark flowing robe with subtle woven embroidery at the collar, elegant and understated. The background is deep black with drifting blue-white foxfire orbs at the edges of the frame. The color palette is warm russet, amber, and gold against consuming darkness. His expression is calm and entertained — someone who always knows something you don't.
